Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**TOPAZ FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (gem), chaotic neutral*
**AC** 20 (natural armor)
**HP** 350 (20d20 + 140)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 25 (+7) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 26 (+8) | **INT** 23 (+6) | **WIS** 21 (+5) | **CHA** 22 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Dex +10, Con +15, Wis +12, Cha +13
**Skills** Intimidation +13, Perception +19, Stealth +10
**Resistances** cold
**Immunities** necrotic
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 29
**Languages** all, telepathy 240 ft.
**CR** 23 (50,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. The dragon can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***At will:*** bane, control water
• ***1/Day each:*** antilife shell, cone of cold, create or destroy water, fabricate
• ***2/Day each:*** ice storm

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Rot.*** Necrotic damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to necrotic damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) necrotic damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Entropy Breath or Desiccating Miasma).
• ***Entropy Breath.*** The dragon gathers a sphere of negative energy and exhales it at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere of entropic influence. All creatures within range must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 65 (10d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Desiccating Miasma.*** A swirling aura of debilitating gas sweeps around the dragon, filling a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on it. Each creature within that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 4d12 cold damage and become weakened for 1 minute. Weakened creatures have disadvantage on Strength-based ability checks, Strength saving throws, and weapon attacks that rely on Strength to deal damage. Weakened creatures can repeat the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

***Psychic Step.*** The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 90 feet of it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web.*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Negative Energy Shield.*** When the dragon is targeted by an attack or effect from a creature it can see, it can drain energy from that creature’s body. That target must succeed a DC 21 Intelligence saving throw, or be weakened until the end of the turn (including on the triggering attack). A creature weakened this way subtracts 1d10 from each attack roll they make, and the save DC of their spells and effects is lowered by 5.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Psionics (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon casts a spell available through Innate Spellcasting.
***Essential Reduction (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon targets a creature or an object that it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they crumble to dust (unless they are magical).
